risk_note: RV2 (content dictionary, no funds). GET /admin/v1/dict for any permission point (guard gets the full admin_permission list, read-only, no audit): defaults from contracts/texts.admin.default.json overlaid by published dict_items read in one REPEATABLE READ snapshot (version first, then rows), no cache; the default file is self-checked (key shape, string values, no key shared with texts.default.json) and a broken file answers 50001. dict-items list / save / rollback accept keys of both default files (orchestrator ruling); admin_dict texts are checked in the admin_report banned-word scope (approved default G5). Public /v1/dict filters out admin_dict rows in SQL and again in the reader; without the filter option the store SQL is unchanged. The frozen [AC-F1-02t#8] already accepts the union key set (F1-02zg #950); F1-02zh tightens it next. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
